$comment: Reference implementations used to prove the 6C-1 interchange profiles against something
other than themselves. These are conformance-time tools only: nothing here is bundled,
linked, or shipped with Soundscaper, so no obligation flows into the AGPL-3.0-only
distribution. They are recorded anyway because a dependency that decides whether a test
passes deserves the same provenance discipline as one that ships.
Every package is Apache-2.0, which is one-way compatible with GPLv3-family licensing and
would remain acceptable even if any of this were ever linked rather than merely executed.
Pure-Python wheels are pinned by sha256 here because they are identical on every platform.
The opentimelineio core is a native extension published as twenty platform wheels, so the
provisioner selects the one matching the running interpreter and verifies it against the
digest PyPI publishes for this exact version. That pins the version and proves the bytes
arrived intact; it does not, and does not claim to, establish trust in PyPI itself.

packages.name: opentimelineio
packages.purpose: OTIO reference reader for the 6C-1b round trip, and the plugin host the adapters below register with.

packages.name: otio-cmx3600-adapter
packages.purpose: Reference CMX3600 reader for the 6C-1a round trip.

packages.name: otio-fcpx-xml-adapter
packages.purpose: Reference FCPXML (Final Cut Pro X) reader for the 6C-1c round trip.
